newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU soymeal active in Europe on tight supply fears.
newsitem.headline: EU soymeal active in Europe on tight supply fears.

text.p: Fears of tight supplies in the period before new crop U.S. soybeans will be arriving into Europe sparked fair activity in nearby EU high protein soymeal here this afternoon, market sources said.

"Sept and Oct positions traded some $3 to $4 up on the day on belief that soybean supplies from South America could run dry before new crop U.S. soybeans hit the market. Nearby Argentine sunmeal also traded well up on tight supply fears, all aided by a slightly weaker dollar," one broker said.
August EU soymeal traded $11 up from yesterday early at $303 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
